status: first form (roadmap controls C1-C3, C7, C8, 14 Nov 2026)
notes: The 9A33BM2's own systems as the crew works them (simcore/vehicle_systems.hpp): the chassis 5937's engine and drive, the 24 V network and the power system's voltages, the lights, the cabin's climate and the «Роса» fire system. The research and its gaps: docs/research/OSA_VEHICLE_SYSTEMS_2026-11.md. Temperatures in degrees C, speeds in km/h as the sources give them (converted at load). Values marked estimate are SAM3D's where no source gives one.
source: voenizdat_osa_1991 pp. 163-176, 222-224, 246-247; mon_2112_80; korovin_tiv_2010; wwp_gecko; and the sources named per value

idle_rpm.source: bmp2_to_studfile (the UTD-20, the 5D20B-300's parent: minimum idle 700-800 rpm)

rated_rpm.source: ru_wiki_baz5937 (300 hp at 2600 rpm, after kochnev_baz); bmp2_to_studfile (the UTD-20's working range to 2600)

working_temperature_c.source: bmp2_to_studfile (UTD-20: coolant and oil recommended 80-100 C)

warm_up_time_constant_s.source: sam3d estimate (a diesel's coolant from cold to working in about 15-20 min at a fast idle)

cool_down_time_constant_s.source: sam3d estimate (a stopped engine's coolant falls to the air's over some hours)

preheat_below_c.source: sam3d estimate after Soviet armoured vehicles' diesel practice (heat the engine before starting it in the cold); the 5937 has a liquid pre-heater (voenizdat_osa_1991 p174), no threshold found

preheat_rate_c_per_s.source: sam3d estimate (the pre-heater brings the coolant up about 3 C a minute)

oil_pressure_idle_kgf_cm2.source: bmp2_to_studfile (UTD-20: not below 2 kgf/cm2 at minimum idle)

oil_pressure_rated_kgf_cm2.source: bmp2_to_studfile (UTD-20: 6-10.5 kgf/cm2 at 2200 rpm with warm oil); the low end taken, since the 5937's gauge reads to 8 (wwp_gecko g085-a)

cold_oil_pressure_factor.source: sam3d estimate (bmp2_to_studfile: up to 13 kgf/cm2 with oil below 55 C, about 1.3-1.4 times the warm figure)

start_current_a.source: sam3d estimate (a heavy diesel's electric starter on 24 V)

fuel_lph_idle.source: sam3d estimate (a 300 hp diesel at a fast idle)

fuel_lph_moving.source: derived from voenizdat_osa_1991 p17 (250 km on dirt roads with 2 h of the turbine from the 300-320 l tank: about 64 l per 100 km at the dirt roads' 30 km/h, voenizdat_osa_1991 p16, docs/research/OSA_VEHICLE_SYSTEMS_2026-11.md section 1.4)

gear_max_kmh.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p16 (60 km/h on the road: top gear); the lower gears sam3d estimate (no ratio found, docs/research/OSA_VEHICLE_SYSTEMS_2026-11.md section 1.3); the gate's order Н, 1-5, З.Х. as the control

blackout_night_kmh.source: kochnev_baz (the Osa up to 25 km/h at night); vokrachko_1963 (a single vehicle under full blackout at most 25 km/h)

drive.afloat_rule_source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p175 (two water jets driven from the gearbox, two hydraulic flaps for steering and reverse), p224 (the wave shield raised before deep water); that both flaps open drive the vehicle ahead: sam3d inference (docs/research/OSA_VEHICLE_SYSTEMS_2026-11.md section 1.6)

electrics.battery_switch_source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p163 (the battery switch ВБ of chassis 5937 is part of the power system), p223 (switched on for the 3.80 m drill); that the red-levered box by the driver is it: sam3d inference, low

battery_v.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p175 (single-wire network, nominal 24 V, two batteries 12СТ-70)

battery_ah.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p175 (two 12СТ-70 in series: 70 A h at 24 V)

charged_v.source: sam3d estimate (a lead-acid battery of twelve cells at rest, fully charged: 2.12 V a cell)

flat_v.source: sam3d estimate (twelve cells near discharge, about 1.92 V a cell at rest)

charge_v.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p163 (the stabilised 27.5 V for excitation, control and charging the batteries, from the rectifier ВУ-1)

min_start_fraction.source: sam3d estimate (below a quarter of its charge the battery no longer turns the starter)

network_load_a.source: sam3d estimate (the radios, intercom, lamps and instruments off the batteries with no source on line)

charge_a.source: sam3d estimate (the charging current at the start of a charge, within the dash ammeter's 40 A scale, wwp_gecko g085-a)

supply_nominal_v.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p163, p247 (220 V 400 Hz read on 0096-9M1's voltmeter before АППАРАТУРА ВКЛ.)

regulator_span_v.source: sam3d estimate (the НАПР. knob trims the С-75's output 12 V either side of 220 V, a little past the working band)

electrics.voltage_rule_source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p163 (the ГОМ's С-75 has a voltage-regulating block); wwp_gecko g084-d (НАПР. ГТА and НАПР. ГОМ on ПУ-303); that they trim the 220 V read on 0096-9M1: sam3d inference, medium

shed_hz.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p163 (УКЧ in ОС52-16М sheds the load when the frequency falls to 360 Hz)

gom_full_rpm.source: sam3d estimate (the engine speed the hand throttle holds for the take-off generator's 400 Hz at a halt; voenizdat_osa_1991 p164 Fig. 2.60 shows the fuel pump's hand lever in the power system)

lights.rule_source: wwp_gecko g085-a (the switches' legends); the central switch's 0, I sidelights, II headlights, and that НАРУЖНОЕ ОСВЕЩЕН. feeds all the outside lamps: sam3d inference (docs/research/OSA_VEHICLE_SYSTEMS_2026-11.md section 3)

blackout_seen_m.source: vokrachko_1963 (under full blackout a vehicle's masked lamps are meant to be seen only from the next in the column: the rear distance indicator's figure seen from 150 m at most)

headlights_seen_m.source: sam3d estimate (no source found for how far a lit vehicle is seen at night; a headlight on open ground is seen a few kilometres off)

blackout_find_factor.source: sam3d estimate (the enemy's armed reconnaissance finds a blacked-out column at night far less often than one by its headlights: air_war/logistics.hpp's night chance is for headlights)

climate.rule_source: voenizdat_osa_1991 pp. 165-169 (ЛЕТО: the separating fans draw outside air through the racks and throw it into the engine compartment; ЗИМА: the air goes round inside the hull, warmed by the racks, and heats the operators' compartment; the fans on with АППАРАТУРА ВКЛ.), p223 (ЛЕТО above 0 C, ЗИМА below -5 C); mon_2112_80 p68 (ЗИМА below -10 C, back to ЛЕТО once the compartment passes +10 C to keep the equipment from overheating)

winter_below_c.source: mon_2112_80 p68 (the Osa-AK's own manual; voenizdat_osa_1991 p223 gives -5 C for the AKM)

equipment_heat_kw.source: sam3d estimate (the racks' share of the equipment's draw from the 50 kW turbine, voenizdat_osa_1991 p163, as heat)

rack_rise_summer_c.source: sam3d estimate (the racks' air over the outside air with the separating fans drawing: four 600 W fans, voenizdat_osa_1991 p167)

rack_rise_still_c.source: sam3d estimate (the racks' rise over the cabin with their hatches shut and no air drawn through)

cabin_rise_winter_c.source: sam3d estimate (the cabin over the outside air with the racks' heat recirculated in ЗИМА; the cabin lined with 5-20 mm of foam, voenizdat_osa_1991 p173)

heater_rise_c.source: sam3d estimate (the ОВ-65Г heater's rise of the cabin over the outside air; korovin_tiv_2010 names it, no output found; the МТО's ОВ-65 keeps +15 +/- 3 C, mon_2112_80 p44)

crew_rise_c.source: sam3d estimate (five men and the instruments in a closed, insulated compartment)

rack_fault_c.source: sam3d estimate (no limit found: voenizdat_osa_1991 p169 and mon_2112_80 p68 say only that the equipment overheats and may fail)

transmitter_rise_c.source: sam3d estimate (the antenna unit's transmitter compartments over the outside air while radiating, with their closed-loop air coolers, voenizdat_osa_1991 p168-169)

magnetron_drift_hz_per_c.source: sam3d estimate (voenizdat_osa_1991 p33: the magnetron's frequency drifts mainly with its cavities' temperature; no rate given)

magnetron_reference_c.source: sam3d estimate (the transmitters' temperature the frequency is set at)

transmitter_overheat_c.source: sam3d estimate (voenizdat_osa_1991 p169: the thermal sensors trip at a critical temperature, not given)

transmitter_fault_after_s.source: sam3d estimate (voenizdat_osa_1991 p169: the compartment concerned may fail)

cold_below_c.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p51 (ОБОГРЕВ heats the gyro when the operators' compartment is below +5 C)

slow_warm_below_c.source: sam3d estimate (no source gives warm-up times that grow with cold: docs/research/OSA_VEHICLE_SYSTEMS_2026-11.md section 4)

frost_humidity_pct.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p223 (after humidity over 80 % and a sudden frost: 15-20 min on the filaments only before the anodes)

comfort_low_c.source: sam3d estimate (cold hands slow a man's work below about +12 C)

comfort_high_c.source: sam3d estimate (heat slows a man's work above about +30 C)

comfort_slow_per_c.source: sam3d estimate (two per cent slower a degree beyond the band)

fire.rule_source: mon_2112_80 p27 and korovin_tiv_2010 (an automatic «Роса» system for the engine and the gas turbine's compartments); btvt_t55 (the «Роса» system: three bottles; automatic, it stops the engine and the fans and fires a bottle after 4-6 s; semi-automatic, it only signals and the driver presses the button); wwp_gecko g086-c (the box: ПРОВЕРКА ЦЕПЕЙ, ПЕРЕВОД ДИСКА — ОСТАТОК БАЛЛОНОВ, ПРИ ПОЖАРЕ ОТКРОЙ КРЫШКУ И НАЖМИ КНОПКУ, two red lamps, three bottles). That the disc must be turned on to the next full bottle after a discharge: sam3d inference, low

bottles.source: btvt_t55 (three bottles); wwp_gecko g086-c (three black bottles by the box)

auto_delay_s.source: btvt_t55 (the agent held 4-6 s for the engine and its fan to stop)

put_out_chance.source: sam3d estimate (one bottle puts a compartment fire out)

burn_to_destroyed_s.source: sam3d estimate (a compartment fire left burning takes the vehicle)

hit_fire_chance.source: sam3d estimate (a fragment hit on the vehicle sets fuel or oil burning in the engine or turbine compartment)
